description: This file defines the TranscribeServiceClient class in the Aws\TranscribeService namespace, which extends Aws\AwsClient. It provides method annotations for interacting with the Amazon Transcribe Service API, including actions for managing transcription jobs, vocabulary, medical vocabulary, and call analytics categories.
